report_name: Whitfield Regional Hospital Breach Exposes Patient Medical Data

identities.name: Whitfield Regional Hospital
identities.description: A hospital in Demopolis, Alabama that suffered a major data breach exposing patient PII, PHI, and financial information between May and June 2025.

indicators.name: Potential Staged Patient Data Archive
indicators.x_netsecio_sigma_rule:
title: Potential Staged Patient Data Archive File Creation
id: 2b8a1c9e-7d6f-4c5a-9b8d-3e4f5a6b7c8d
status: experimental
description: Detects the creation of a file named 'patients.zip', which could indicate the staging of patient data for exfiltration, as hinted in the Whitfield Regional Hospital breach analysis.
references:
  - https://www.morningstar.com/news/pr-newswire/20260728ph13541/whitfield-regional-hospital-data-breach-edelson-lechtzin-llp-launches-investigation-into-exposure-of-personal-information
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-07-28
tags:
  - attack.t1560.001
  - attack.collection
level: high
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    TargetFilename|endswith: '\patients.zip'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the creation of a file named 'patients.zip', which could be an indicator of data being archived for exfiltration.

indicators.name: Suspicious Encoded PowerShell Command Execution
indicators.pattern:
title: Suspicious Encoded PowerShell Command Execution
id: f1c2d3e4-a5b6-4c7d-8e9f-0a1b2c3d4e5f
status: experimental
description: Detects the use of encoded PowerShell commands, a common technique for obfuscating malicious activity and a hunting hint from the Whitfield Hospital breach report.
references:
  - https://www.morningstar.com/news/pr-newswire/20260728ph13541/whitfield-regional-hospital-data-breach-edelson-lechtzin-llp-launches-investigation-into-exposure-of-personal-information
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-07-28
tags:
  - attack.t1059.001
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1027
  - attack.defense_evasion
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
    CommandLine|contains: ' -enc '
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the execution of PowerShell with the '-enc' argument, a common TTP for running obfuscated commands, suggested as a hunting hint in the article.

indicators.name: Domain Trust Discovery with Nltest
indicators.pattern:
title: Domain Trust Discovery with Nltest
id: 9e8d7c6b-5a4f-4e3d-2c1b-0a9f8e7d6c5b
status: experimental
description: Detects the use of 'nltest /dclist' to enumerate domain controllers, a discovery technique mentioned as a hunting hint.
references:
  - https://www.morningstar.com/news/pr-newswire/20260728ph13541/whitfield-regional-hospital-data-breach-edelson-lechtzin-llp-launches-investigation-into-exposure-of-personal-information
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-07-28
tags:
  - attack.t1482
  - attack.discovery
level: medium
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\nltest.exe'
    CommandLine|contains: '/dclist:'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the use of the 'nltest' utility to discover domain controllers, a technique suggested for threat hunting in the article.
